name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 104 – Am 9
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 104b. Calls for EU-funded NGOs to refrain from political activities aimed at influencing electoral outcomes or the democratic choice of voters; stresses that NGOs must not be used as instruments of electoral interference or indirect political campaigning, and calls for effective transparency and safeguards to prevent EU funding from being used for such purposes;
